transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, um… I guess what brings me in is this restless feeling I’ve been having. It’s not terrible, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but I feel sort of wound too tight a lot of the time, like I can’t fully settle.

Even when I’m supposed to be sitting calmly through a planning meeting, or doing something relaxing like painting or yoga, I still feel… keyed up inside. I’m not sure if that makes sense.

Do you find that this feeling of restlessness happens in different situations throughout your day, or does it mostly happen in specific circumstances, like social situations or after stressful events?

I think it’s… pretty much across the day, not just one specific situation. I mean, it’s not like I’m falling apart or anything, but I notice it even in normal things—like sitting in a planning meeting, or when I’m trying to do something that should be calming, like painting or yoga.

It’s just this wound-up feeling, like I can’t fully settle. Does that answer what you mean?
When you feel this restlessness, do you also notice things like racing thoughts, trouble focusing, or a lot of physical tension in your body?

I’m not totally sure about racing thoughts or anything like that… I don’t want to overstate it. It’s more that I just feel physically and internally restless, like I’m wound too tight and can’t quite settle.

Even if I’m just supposed to be sitting calmly in a planning meeting, or doing something nice like painting or yoga, there’s still this keyed-up feeling. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things, even when there isn’t a clear reason for concern?

I don’t think so… not in a constant way. I mean, I worry about normal things, work or family stuff, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around worrying for no reason all the time.

At least, I haven’t really noticed that as the main issue. Is that what you mean?
Do you ever feel like you can't relax, even when there's nothing pressing going on or when you're by yourself?

Yes… I think that’s actually a good way to put it. Even when nothing urgent is happening, or I’m by myself, I still don’t feel fully relaxed.

It’s not dramatic, exactly—I can function—but I feel kind of wound too tight, like my body or brain won’t quite settle down. Like even in a quiet moment, or when I’m doing something that should be calming, I’m still sort of restless underneath. Does that make sense?
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, even when you’re tired?

Um… I don’t think that’s a big problem for me, at least not that I’ve noticed. I mean, everyone has the occasional night where it takes a bit to drift off, but I wouldn’t say I’m regularly lying there exhausted and unable to sleep, or waking up a lot.

Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Do you often feel unusually tired or like you don’t have much energy, even if you’re not doing anything particularly demanding?

Not really, no. I mean, I get tired like anyone does, especially after a busy day, but I wouldn’t say I feel unusually drained for no reason.

I usually have enough energy to get through what I need to do. So… I don’t think that’s one of the bigger things for me, if that helps.
Have you noticed yourself becoming more irritable or easily annoyed lately, even by things that wouldn’t usually bother you?

I don’t think so, no… not in a noticeable way. I mean, I can get annoyed like anyone, especially if things are chaotic or people are being difficult, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually irritable lately.

At least, nothing that stands out to me as out of character. Does that answer what you mean?
Do you find that you worry a lot about different everyday things, even when you know logically that there may not be much to worry about?

I wouldn’t say I worry a lot, no. I mean, I think about normal things — work stuff, family things, just the usual — but it doesn’t feel like constant worrying or like I can’t turn it off.

At least, I don’t think so. If there’s a specific kind of worry you mean, I can try to answer that better.

Have you ever experienced sudden episodes where you feel intense anxiety, a racing heart, shortness of breath, or a feeling like something terrible is going to happen, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had moments where I feel stressed or keyed up, but not like a sudden episode where my heart is racing and I can’t breathe or I feel like something awful is about to happen.

At least, nothing like that comes to mind. I don’t think I’ve had panic-type episodes, if that’s what you mean.
Do you find that you feel anxious or on edge much of the time, even when there isn’t a specific reason for it?

Not really, no. I don’t think I’m anxious or on edge most of the time. I mean, I can get a little tense when there’s a lot going on, but it doesn’t feel like it’s there for no reason or happening all day.

I hope that makes sense — I wouldn’t want to overstate it.
